### Jesus Reveals His Purpose in Coming
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jesus-reveals-his-purpose-coming
Passage: Mark 8:31-32
Points:
- Jesus silenced public talk of His messiahship because the surrounding culture held flawed, purely triumphant expectations.
- The vocation of the Son of Man requires humiliation and suffering before resurrection and royal enthronement.
- Christ spoke plainly of His death because bearing the penalty for sin was essential to God's redemptive plan.
- Believers must study all of Scripture to understand Christ's true mission rather than entertaining selective assumptions.

### What Did Jesus Mean By "Get behind Me Satan"?
Author: Clarence L. Haynes Jr.
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/important-reminders-from-the-command-get-behind-me-satan.html
Passage: Matthew 16:21-23
Points:
- Jesus explained that His impending suffering, death, and resurrection were indispensable requirements for human salvation.
- Peter's rebuke was driven by self-interest and unintentionally aligned him with Satan's opposition to God.
- Peter became a stumbling block by speaking to the human dread of pain rather than God's redemptive purpose.
- Victory over temptation requires immediately eliminating the obstacle or removing oneself from its presence.
- Disciples need the Holy Spirit to discern selfish motives and realign human thinking with divine priorities.
